name: three-word kinetic run defines the skill in its own voice
looks: A bold condensed word with a bright drop shadow lands on a light field, then crossfades to the same word restated with a short italic definition line beneath it, like a dictionary entry. A hard cut flips to a dark field where a single italic word glows in the accent colour, then another hard cut lands a short, blunt word in heavy caps on a saturated colour field.
build: Word one is DOM text with an offset solid-colour shadow duplicate; it holds, then a definition line fades in beneath it on a held frame. The next two beats are separate hard-cut word layers, each on its own full-bleed field colour (dark, then accent), cut exactly on the beat with no easing between cuts.
sound: A soft thud as the first word lands, a page-turn tick into the definition, then a dry hit on each of the following two hard cuts.
prompt: Spell out a short verb phrase as three beats: a bold word with its own dictionary-style definition line underneath, then a lone italic word glowing in the accent colour on a dark field, then a short blunt word in heavy caps on a saturated colour field, each a hard cut with its own look so the phrase reads as three distinct moves rather than one caption.
